name: The square fountain
words: A placed 3D model with five notes on it; the open note's card travels between its point on the model and the screen.

notes.title: The basin
notes.text: Eight stone panels make the basin. The worn dip in the rim is where buckets were rested, one after another, for three hundred years.

notes.title: The lion spout
notes.text: Water still runs from the lion's mouth. Its nose is bright and smooth because people rub it for luck as they pass.

notes.title: The upper bowl
notes.text: The shallow bowl spreads the water into a thin veil. On frosty mornings the veil freezes and the bowl wears a crown of ice.

notes.title: The pinecone
notes.text: A stone pinecone tops the column, an old sign of plenty. This one was carved again after a storm threw the first one down.

notes.title: The mason's mark
notes.text: Low on the back panel: a small carved star and two letters. Each mason signed the stone, so the guild knew whose work it was.
